origin.description: Fehlberg (7,8) pair. Thirteen derivative evaluations per attempt, and the step advances with the eighth-order estimate.
origin.usage: ode78(f, t0, tfinal, y0, ..., atol = 1e-6, hmax = 0.0)

arguments.name: y0
arguments.text: Initial value, a vector or one column.

origin.details: y' = -y, y(0) = 1, on [0, 0.4]. The check vector is the solution column.
origin.value: Fehlberg (7,8) pair. Thirteen derivative evaluations per attempt, and the step advances with the eighth-order estimate.
